'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Government and intergovernmental reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****Russian [[diplomat]] [[Boris Bondarev]] says that he has resigned to protest the invasion of [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-diplomat-switzerland-says-he-resigns-over-ukraine-invasion-2022-05-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Iraq (2017–present)|ISIL insurgency in Iraq]]
**[[Islamic State]] carries out a pair of attacks in the [[Iraq]]i [[Diyala Governorate|Diyala]] and [[Kirkuk Governorate]]s, killing twelve civilians and injuring another six. [https://apnews.com/article/islamic-state-group-iraq-middle-east-bc0b80e462aa5bff65dab3d234d3bc6e (AP)]
*[[Rwanda]]n authorities accuse the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] of [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] areas in [[Musanze District]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-rwanda-kigali-f15398437a0f83c1939e8208d84179cd (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 KwaZulu-Natal floods]]
**300 people are displaced by new [[flood]]ing in [[KwaZulu-Natal]], [[South Africa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/floods-politics-durban-south-africa-434bd39f6d74ffc3174c6a21720f6766 (AP)]
*Seven people are killed and 23 others are injured when a [[high-speed craft]] carrying 134 people catches fire off the coast of [[Real, Quezon|Real]], [[Quezon]], [[Philippines]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/philippine-ferry-fire-at-least-seven-dead-and-120-rescued-after-blaze-12619426 (Sky News)]
*Fourteen people are killed and dozens are injured when a [[building collapse]]s in [[Abadan]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-61548490 (BBC News)]
*Two people are killed and 120 others are injured when a [[gas cylinder]] catches fire and explodes at a restaurant in [[Abu Dhabi]], [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/several-wounded-abu-dhabi-restaurant-gas-explosion-police-2022-05-23/ (Reuters)]
*A [[mudflow]] hits the village of [[Ak-Suu, Jalal-Abad|Ak-Suu]], [[Aksy District]], [[Kyrgyzstan]], cutting off access to the village and trapping three cars. [https://akipress.com/news:671280:Mudflow_isolates_entire_village_in_Aksy_district/?place=main2 (AKIPress)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Telangana]]
*****[[Telangana]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant#Sublineages and BA.2 subvariant|Omicron BA.5 variant]] in an 80-year old person with no history of travel. [https://indianexpress.com/article/india/insacog-first-case-ba-5-sub-variant-omicron-telangana-7931275/lite/ (''The Indian Express'')] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Beijing]]
*****[[Beijing]] extends its stay-at-home order for workers and students, and orders mass [[COVID-19 testing]] amid an increase in the number of [[COVID-19]] cases in the city. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/Health/wireStory/beijing-extends-work-home-order-covid-19-cases-84902954 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
***Emeritus Queen consort [[Queen Sofía of Spain|Sofía of Spain]] tests positive for COVID-19 after travelling to [[Miami]], [[Florida]], [[United States]]. [https://www.diezminutos.es/familia-real/monarquia-espanola/a40081716/reina-sofia-covid-pierde-comida-familia-rey-juan-carlos/ (''Diez Minutos'')]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Pfizer]] and [[BioNTech]] say that [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|their COVID-19 vaccine]] is 80% effective in young children. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/2022/05/23/children-coronavirus-vaccine-pfizer-data/ (''The Washington Post'')] 
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Scotland]] confirms its first case of [[monkeypox]]. The patient has been hospitalized. In response, [[smallpox vaccine|smallpox vaccines]] are being stockpiled in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/scotland-confirms-first-case-monkeypox-2022-05-23/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-61549385.amp (BBC News)] [https://www.glasgowtimes.co.uk/news/scottish-news/20160014.amp/ (''Glasgow Times'')]
**[[Denmark]] confirms its first case of monkeypox. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/denmark-registers-first-case-monkeypox-infection-health-ministry-2022-05-23/ (Reuters)]
**[[England]] reports 36 more monkeypox cases, thereby bringing the total number of cases in the country to 56. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/scotland-confirms-first-case-monkeypox-2022-05-23/ (Reuters)]
**The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention|U.S. CDC]] says that American health officials are releasing [[Smallpox vaccine#Jynneos|Jynneos]] [[vaccine]]s to combat monkeypox. [https://www.axios.com/2022/05/23/monkeypox-cdc-jynneos-vaccine (Axios)]
**[[Morocco]] reports three new suspected cases of [[monkeypox]]. [https://english.news.cn/20220524/bf0a3d0f2d7b4921b969ee9f15664a28/c.html (Xinhua News Agency)]
*[[Polio eradication]], [[Polio in Pakistan]]
**[[Pakistan]] launches a new anti-[[polio]] drive after a third case of the disease is reported in the country. [https://www.registercitizen.com/news/amp/Pakistan-launches-new-anti-polio-drive-after-3rd-17191474.php (''The Register Citizen'')]
*In [[Australia]], [[Premier of Queensland|Queensland Premier]] [[Annastacia Palaszczuk]] announces that [[Queensland]] residents will have access to [[Influenza vaccine|influenza vaccines]] across the state amid an increase in the number of [[Influenza A virus|influenza A]] cases after two years of low case numbers due to COVID-19. [https://7news.com.au/lifestyle/health-wellbeing/qld-govt-to-make-flu-jabs-free-c-6903011.amp (Seven News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Cross-Strait relations]], [[China–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] states that [[American troops]] would defend [[Taiwan]] militarily in the event of a [[China|Chinese]] invasion, a departure from a traditional policy of strategic ambiguity. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/05/23/world/asia/biden-taiwan-china.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War]], [[Turkish occupation of northern Syria]]
**[[Turkish president]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] threatens to launch a new [[Turkish Armed Forces|military]] incursion into northern [[Syria]], targeting US-backed Kurdish [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] and expanding its occupation zone along Syria's northern border with Turkey. [https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2022/05/turkey-threatens-new-syria-incursion-amid-nato-debate (Al-Monitor)]

**In the first trial for [[war crime]]s during the Russian invasion of Ukraine, 21-year-old [[Vadim Shishimarin]], a Russian soldier, is sentenced to [[life in prison]] for fatally shooting a 62-year-old civilian. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/05/23/europe/ukraine-russian-soldier-war-crimes-trial-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*A [[security guard]] is killed at the [[Qatari embassy]] in [[Paris]], [[France]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/one-person-killed-qatar-embassy-paris-le-parisien-2022-05-23/ (Reuters)]
